intent: Implement EvoPilot Runtime 6.0.0 as an Agent-native Harness-guided Lifecycle control plane with Runtime-owned tenant/workspace Lifecycle Registry CRUD, immutable revision bindings, mandatory ordinary-human Evolution Expert interaction over MCP, qualified external Agent Runtime source execution, frozen legacy Suite fixtures, and exact installed-Candidate completion.
objective: Deliver Runtime 6.0.0 as the public project-neutral control plane that lets third-party projects create, inspect, evolve, activate, execute, recover, and roll back declarative Pipeline Lifecycles independently of Runtime source while preserving a real immutable HarnessBundle-guided Goal Target Loop, explicit authority, durable Runtime truth, and external Agent execution.

evidence.authority: Exact authorization to apply the v6 Roadmap and draft/preflight this Target; not Target approval or implementation authority.
Current authoritative machine Roadmap declaring Runtime 6.0.0 and Expert 2.0.0.
Approved replacement architecture boundary applied with the Roadmap; not implementation evidence.
Bounded recovery authorization and successful complete validation evidence; no product authority.
Published Runtime 5.0.1 compatibility baseline inherited criterion by criterion.
Superseded unreleased development evidence only; its Candidate evidence cannot prove v6 acceptance.

include: Implement Runtime-owned tenant/workspace LifecycleDefinition and immutable LifecycleRevision aggregates with complete governed CRUD, activation, archive, restore, rollback, dependency, usage, audit, referential-integrity, idempotency, concurrency, and crash-recovery contracts.

Implement human-readable YAML import and composition over a closed versioned Action and Capability Registry; reject arbitrary executable content, raw secrets, hidden authority, cycles, missing dependencies, and weakened Harness obligations.

Bind ProjectDefinition, GoalTarget, one resolved LifecycleRevision, one real published immutable HarnessExecutionBinding, policies, inputs, Host, Agent Runtime, authority, and evidence at planning and every Loop boundary.

Implement Runtime-owned MCP Human Interaction Protocol facts and decision frames consumed by independently installed Evolution Expert Host Integration Bundles; keep HTTP, CLI, CI, events, and webhooks as administrator, machine, diagnostics, and recovery surfaces.

Implement qualified external Agent Runtime discovery, capability negotiation, exact pendingExecution dispatch, normalized receipt/trajectory/usage/artifact/evidence validation, duplicate suppression, uncertainty reconciliation, and resume without an embedded general-purpose Agent fallback.

Support Codex and OpenCode execution, independent Agent Runtime conformance, Codex and Claude Code Host adapters, designated-human WorkBuddy, generic Agent, generic MCP, and headless machine paths without Host-specific business semantics.

Treat EvoPilot Suite 3.2.1 and DataRig Suite 2.1.5 only as frozen reference and migration fixtures; provide DataRig, EvoPilot, evopilot-harness, and unknown-project declarations with zero privileged Engine branch or ongoing Suite synchronization.

Synchronize README and complete installation, Expert-first operation, concepts, DDD architecture, Lifecycle Registry, MCP, Agent Runtime, Harness binding, security, recovery, migration, operations, acceptance, and release documentation.

Build criterion-specific validators and an exact completion aggregator for every current, inherited, E2E, impact, and NO_REGRESSION obligation; counted acceptance must use exact installed private Runtime 6.0.0 and Expert 2.0.0 Candidates.

Prepare post-release legacy Suite Cutover migration evidence only; leave currently installed Suites active and untouched pending public installation validation and a separate Cutover Target and authorization.
exclude: No Harness reasoning, authoring, review, approval, evaluation, Catalog or Registry mutation, signing, or publication in EvoPilot.
No embedded general-purpose coding Agent, hidden Agent Runtime fallback, unqualified execution provider, or Runtime-owned model/tool loop.
No direct ordinary-human CLI or HTTP fallback around Evolution Expert over MCP; administrator and machine recovery surfaces remain non-ordinary-human interfaces.
No project-specific Runtime branch, privileged DataRig/EvoPilot/evopilot-harness profile, legacy Suite invocation, or continuing Suite synchronization.
No raw credential capture, arbitrary executable Lifecycle YAML, implicit authority, production/database access, or destructive external effect.
No actual legacy Suite default switch, disablement, movement, archive, uninstall, deletion, or retirement before separate post-release Cutover authorization.
No v5.1 Candidate or source-checkout result may substitute for exact installed v6 Candidate acceptance.
No commit, push, Candidate, acceptance, Host operation, publication, or Release under this unapproved draft.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Install exact Candidate Host Integration Bundle in Codex, discover Expert, verify MCP health and versions, and run a side-effect-free tutorial.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Isolated installed-Candidate transcript, package and Core digests, MCP health, version, and no-side-effect evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Install the same Expert Core and MCP semantics in Claude Code.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Isolated installed-Candidate Host conformance evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: A designated human installs WorkBuddy integration and completes the frozen representative journey without Codex operation or observation.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Designated-human frozen-runbook declaration bound to exact Candidate and criterion range.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: An unknown project creates, validates, and registers a human-readable Pipeline through Expert and MCP with zero Runtime source diff.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Resource revisions, validation, repository diff, and MCP transcript.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Read consistent list, inspect, dependency, usage, active revision, resolved graph, automation, authority, rollback, and audit views.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Cross-surface equality evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Create a successor revision that affects future runs while an existing run retains its exact bound digest.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Concurrent old/new run bindings and semantic diff.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Deactivate a Lifecycle so future binding stops while active and historical runs remain intact.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Binding rejection and historical-state integrity evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Archive, inspect history, restore, and reject prohibited physical deletion of referenced revisions.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Archive/restore/delete decision and audit evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Rollback the active pointer to an exact retained revision with immutable audit and no evidence loss.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Pointer, revision, evidence, and audit digests before and after rollback.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Compose reusable base and modules while cycles, duplicate identities, arbitrary execution, and weakened Harness obligations fail closed.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Positive resolved graph and negative diagnostic corpus.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Use identical Lifecycle identities in two tenants and prove isolation through registration, activation, execution, and audit.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Two-tenant isolation and cross-scope rejection evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Restart Runtime and recover Registry, pointers, bindings, runs, receipts, and audit without reconstructing chat history.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Process-restart persistence and resume evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Reject raw secrets, arbitrary shell, hidden prompts, unknown actions, unqualified providers, permission expansion, and cross-scope references.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Adversarial security matrix with no prohibited effect.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Expert starts a Harness-guided Goal Target Loop, Runtime issues exact pendingExecution, a qualified external Agent Runtime performs bounded source work, and Runtime validates its receipt.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: End-to-end pendingExecution, trajectory, normalized receipt, source closure, and Loop transition evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Codex creates, Claude Code inspects, and designated-human WorkBuddy authorizes one Runtime-owned object without semantic divergence.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Runtime object digest equality plus designated-human authority declaration.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: DataRig changes, activates, runs, and rolls back a Pipeline revision with zero Runtime source diff.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: DataRig declaration-only lifecycle and repository diff evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: EvoPilot consumes a real published HarnessBundle and completes a Harness-guided repository Goal Target Loop.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Published HarnessBundle export, selection, binding, Loop, source, test, and evidence chain.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: evopilot-harness operates as a governed project without transferring Harness asset authority to EvoPilot.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Project operation and explicit Harness authority-boundary evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Representative success, failure, repair, resume, upgrade, and rollback journeys pass with both legacy Suites absent.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Discovery/dependency scan and legacySuiteInvocationCount=0 across all journeys.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: After every required journey passes, the exact installed Runtime 6.0.0 and Expert 2.0.0 Candidate pair completes a 5400-second active soak.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Continuous active-workload timeline, health, errors, resource use, and exact Candidate binding.
